$$A(y) = \sum_{j: i_j \text{ even}} (1+y)^{m_j}, \qquad B(y) = \sum_{j: i_j \text{ odd}} (1+y)^{m_j}.$$

Then $R(x) = \sum_{j=1}^n (1+x)^{i_j} = A(x^2) + (1+x)B(x^2) = (A+B)(x^2) + xB(x^2)$.

$$o(R) = o(A+B) + o(B). \tag{$\star$}$$
